name: Maple
note: Pale and bright, with a quiet ripple of figure that moves as the light does.

name: Olive
note: Honey-gold with dark, wandering streaks. No two pairs look alike.
alt: A pair of olive wood pickup covers with dark swirling grain on linen

name: Padauk

alt: A pair of bright red padauk pickup covers on linen

name: Purpleheart
note: Violet straight from the board — the same wood as the Mathetēs center stripe.
alt: A pair of purpleheart pickup covers in deep violet on linen

name: Walnut
note: Chocolate and straight-grained. The quiet one that goes with everything.
alt: A pair of dark walnut pickup covers on linen
